Name: Victorian Gothic Town Buildings (BETA)
Author: porkiichop
Description:
[i]Disclaimer: This mod is currently under development, so information is likely to change often until its completion. The full mod will be available Fall-Winter 2025 (updated 08/03/25).[/i]

This is a Content Patcher and SMAPI-required modding pack. You will need to download those to run the mod.

[color=#fff2cc][size=4][b]What It Includes:[/b][/size]
[/color]
﻿- Palette Recolor - Dark Violets and Desaturation
﻿- Architecture/Building Style - Victorian Queen Anne

[color=#fff2cc][size=4][b]Updates:[/b][/size][/color]

[b]-All past updates are now included in all season maps (NEW 1.2.0)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Note: some variation included for the winter map, more seasonal variations in the works for all seasons[/b][/*]
[/list]
- Pierre's General Store and Harvey's Clinic Reskin 
- The Stardrop Saloon Reskin 
- Museum Reskin  
- Mayor's Manor Reskin (Updated deletion of reskinned plants for now 1.2.0)
- Blacksmith Reskin
- Town lamp Reskin/Recolor
- Town picket fence Recolor [b](Updated recolor 1.2.0 - less jarring contrast and saturation)[/b]

[i][color=#fff2cc][size=4][b]Future Updates Will Include (Coming Soon!):[/b][/size]
[/color]
- Spring Town Full Reskin
- Summer Town Full Reskin
- Fall Town Full Reskin
- Winter Town Full Reskin

**will include other various non-farm buildings around Pelican Town's map**
[/i]
Thank you for your support! <3
